faqs.a:
Whenever in any section of this article, or any section of a rule or regulation promulgated
               hereunder, the doing of any act is required, prohibited or declared to be unlawful,
               any person, firm, or corporation who shall be convicted of a violation of any such
               section shall, for each offense, be punishable by a fine, or by imprisonment, or both,
               not to exceed the limits established in
section 1-5
.
(Code 1981, § 33-125; Ord. No. 3127, § 24, 10-24-1994)
